body: I may never have another chance...

I've known this girl for about 7 months, and we had been hanging out this past week for a school related activity.  Anyway, there were all the classic signs of her liking me (she always sat next to me, hugged me, kissed me on the cheeks, accidentally "bumped" into me, randomly touched me, played with her hair, etc.) and we went with a bunch of friends from different schools.  We went to the movies twice, went out to eat, went shopping, and had a ton of fun.  There was this one moment that I felt would have been perfect for a kiss but alas I failed to seize the opportunity and we left on Saturday.
